_comment_top: Claude Code project settings - hook wiring for specwright. PowerShell version (Windows). For bash adaptation, see _bash_adaptation at bottom.

_pwsh_recommended._comment: SW-50: the hooks below run under Windows PowerShell 5.1 by default - the safe universal baseline (README/install docs only promise 'PowerShell 5.1+'). Whether PowerShell 7+ (pwsh) starts faster depends on the machine: on one developer workstation 5.1 was about 2x slower, on GitHub's windows-latest runner it was about 20% FASTER - see docs/architecture.md 'Hook invocation latency'. Measure on your own machine first with tests/hooks/measure-latency.ps1 (it times both flavors). If pwsh wins there, switch each hook entry's 'command' AND add a 'shell' field exactly as shown below; do not just rename the executable inside 'command', or you will launch pwsh, which then launches ANOTHER copy of literal powershell.exe from inside it - twice the startup cost. Empirically verified: Claude Code's 'shell':'powershell' hook field runs the command through pwsh (Core), not Desktop Windows PowerShell, and '${HOME}' still expands correctly in this shell-invoked form.

_bash_adaptation._comment: On macOS/Linux replace PowerShell command lines with bash invocations. Make hooks executable (chmod +x) and adjust file extension.
_bash_adaptation._note_powershell_on_unix: The PowerShell command lines above invoke the literal 'powershell' executable, which does not exist on Unix even when pwsh 7+ is installed there (Unix invokes it as 'pwsh', with no 'powershell' shim by default) - use the bash variants on macOS/Linux, not the PowerShell command lines as-is.

_schema_notes._hook_output_format: spec-gate emits dual-format JSON for forward and backward CLI compatibility.
_schema_notes._both_emitted: Both fields are present in the same JSON object. The CLI reads whichever it understands; the other field is ignored harmlessly.

_timeout_notes.sessionStart: 5s - inject in-progress specs and the constitution pointer once per session (startup, resume, fork, compact, clear - SW-67)
_timeout_notes.userPromptSubmit: 5s - inject per-prompt routing hints (workflow keywords, ticket IDs)
_timeout_notes.preToolUse: 5s - check spec-gate before code edits and shell writes to protected paths (Bash | PowerShell, SW-79)
